propositions: Introduce a new rotation sidecar file (.bridge_state/get_rotation.json) to replace inline GET-rotation tracking while dual-writing both sidecar and legacy inline fields during rollout to support old-binary interleaving.
Implement fail-open rotation module that reads chronological max(sidecar, legacy) per Jira key and persists new stamps to both files only on BindingStore.save() paths, not during reconcile-check.
Extract outbound wrappers into a focused rotation module to keep outbound_differ.py at or below 800 lines while wiring BindingStore and outbound_differ to shared rotation accessors.
Add GET_ROTATION_FILE constant in git_adapter.py and include it in explicit local staging and basename checks in reconcile_helpers.py so both dual-written files land in one commit without git add -A.

An idempotent real-repo pass with no absent-key GETs after initialization must leave all bridge-state files byte-identical and not advance HEAD; passes with absent-key GETs intentionally advance and commit both rotation representations.

Legacy-only binding stores must preserve rotation order and materialize equivalent sidecar state on persisted save; reconcile-check against pre-migration stores must not create or modify get_rotation.json.
